summary: Comprehensive backend validation of PunyaVerse FastAPI API. Executed 46 pytest cases covering health, catalog (43 temples / 8 packages), transport compare, trip-builder, festivals, weather, crowd, JWT auth, bookings, Stripe checkout (real test key — returned valid stripe.com URL), payment status polling, AI plan (GPT-5.2 fallback chain), reviews, wishlist, full role hierarchy (user/employee/admin/superadmin), and the hidden Sanctum portal header guard. All 46 tests PASSED.
action_items: No backend fixes required. Backend is production-ready for the tested feature set.
Optional enhancement: rate-limit AI/plan endpoint (currently any authenticated user can spam ~30s LLM calls).
Optional: enforce stronger password policy (currently min_length=6).
Optional: store JWT_SECRET refresh strategy + token revocation list for superadmin role-change scenarios.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py reads JWT_SECRET at import-time via os.environ[...] — fails fast (good), but ensure JWT_SECRET is documented in .env.example.
routes_app.py /payments/checkout hard-codes INR→USD at 83 — fine for Stripe test, but should be configurable (env var or live FX) for production.
Mongo _id is correctly excluded everywhere via {'_id': 0} projection — verified.
Role guards are consistent and correct: admin_users explicitly hides superadmin role from admin queries (verified).
Idempotent seeding in server.py.seed_db is well-implemented; admin/employee/user demo accounts only created if absent.
Stripe webhook handler at /api/webhook/stripe correctly idempotent (only updates if not already paid).
Pydantic EmailStr rejects .test/.example/.invalid TLDs (RFC 6761). Not a backend bug, but a footgun for tests — documented in test file.
test_credentials: User: yatri@punyaverse.com / Yatri@2026 | Employee: employee@punyaverse.com / Employee@2026 | Admin: admin@punyaverse.com / Admin@2026 | SuperAdmin: sanctum@punyaverse.internal / K@ilash#Sanctum2026!
seed_data_creation: Test created a few TEST_-prefixed throwaway users + 1 booking + 1 review + 1 wishlist entry + 1 AI itinerary against demo yatri user. Stripe sessions created in test mode are harmless. Not cleaned up — main agent may add cleanup fixtures later if regression suite is repeated frequently.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_punyaverse_backend.py is the canonical regression suite. All 46 tests pass against the deployed preview URL. Stripe test key returns real stripe.com URLs (verified). AI fallback chain confirmed via /api/superadmin/system showing ['openai/gpt-5.2','anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5','gemini/gemini-3-flash-preview']. The /api/ai/plan endpoint took ~6–25s — the test uses a 90s timeout. Note: Pydantic EmailStr rejects RFC 6761 reserved TLDs (.test, .example, .invalid, .localhost) — use real-looking domains like punyaversetest.com for synthetic test data.
